You are a Python engineer. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge (detached at HEAD). Edit files here directly. NEVER git commit, never touch /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge itself, never run `uv`, NEVER call a model, NEVER use the network. FIRST run: [ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv . Environment for every command: `export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp`. Ruff: `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check <files>` and `.venv/bin/python -m ruff format <files>` (line length 120, Python 3.12). Never pass --cov to pytest. Run tests as `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 0 <files>`.

BACKGROUND. `factory/stations/fix_plan.py` `lint_plan` (read it and `tests/test_factory_fix_plan.py`, and the `producers` helper it uses) checks a planner's fix plan before Codex builds it. It already has `plan.redundant_effect`: a beat whose `sets` fact is already set by something else must pin the opposite value in `when`. A real run showed that rule is not enough. The planner proposed a beat at turn 5 that sets fact F (guarded with F false) while an existing pacing event E at turn 8 also sets F. The engine's own test `test_pressure_event_fires_at_its_turn_when_its_conditions_hold` (tests/test_game_path_completion.py) runs each pacing event at the turns just before and at its turn and asserts that, before E's turn, every effect fact of E is NOT yet true. The new early beat made F true at turn 5, so E's test failed, and three Codex rounds were wasted on a plan no worker could make pass. The lint must catch this before any worker runs.

BUILD. In `lint_plan`, for `add_pacing_beat` plans, add a rule with the problem prefix `plan.earlier_than_producer`: for every `sets` fact F and value v of the new beat, when an existing PACING EVENT (not a storylet or claim; use whatever `producers` exposes, or read `package.pacing.events` directly: an event whose effects set F to v) has `at_turn` GREATER than the new beat's `at_turn`, the plan is refused with the message `plan.earlier_than_producer beat at turn {T} sets {F}, which pacing event {id} (turn {U}) also sets; that event's test needs {F} unset before turn {U}, so use turn {U} or later, or set a fact nothing else sets`. A beat at the same turn or later than every such event is NOT refused by this rule (the existing `plan.redundant_effect` rule still applies as today). One problem per (fact, event) pair, in a stable order. Keep every existing message and rule unchanged; keep the function readable (a small helper).

TESTS in `tests/test_factory_fix_plan.py` (hermetic, real default story package as the file already uses). Name them exactly: `test_rejects_beat_that_sets_a_fact_an_existing_later_beat_sets` (the plan `{beat id drawer_gap_noticed_1a, at_turn 5, sets {drawer_gap_pointed_out: true}, when {drawer_gap_pointed_out: false, memory_card_recovered: false}}` on scene 1A, built from the file's existing helpers, is refused with a problem starting `plan.earlier_than_producer` that names `reyes_rams_drawer_1a` and turn 8), `test_beat_at_or_after_the_producer_turn_is_not_refused_by_the_earlier_rule` (the same plan with `at_turn` 8 and then 9 has no `plan.earlier_than_producer` problem), `test_earlier_rule_ignores_beats_that_set_no_shared_fact` (a plan that sets a fact nothing else sets, at turn 5, gets no such problem). Update the existing tests only where this rule legitimately changes their expectation (the existing `test_redundant_effect_is_allowed_with_opposite_guard` checks only for the `plan.redundant_effect` prefix, so it should be unaffected; keep it that way). KNOWN CONSEQUENCE: the shared test fixtures in `tests/test_factory_wiring.py` (and any in `tests/test_factory_planner.py` or `tests/test_factory_manifests.py`) use a beat at turn 10 that sets `drawer_opened`, while the current story has a pacing event at turn 12 that also sets it, so the new rule correctly refuses those fixture plans. Fix those fixtures minimally and keep their intent (for example use turn 12 or later, or a different declared fact that nothing else sets); do not weaken the new rule to make them pass. The file runs in under 15 seconds.

HARD LIMITS. Edit only the owned files: factory/stations/fix_plan.py, tests/test_factory_fix_plan.py, tests/test_factory_wiring.py, tests/test_factory_planner.py, tests/test_factory_manifests.py. Never edit story data, `storygame/`, `factory/stations/wiring.py`, `factory/stations/planner.py` or any other test. Write NOTES_18E4.txt (worktree root, never committed) listing every ambiguity and your choice.
tasks.check:
set -eo pipefail
WORK=/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/factory-lint-earlier
mkdir -p "$WORK/out"
export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp
[ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv
git add -A -- factory tests
bad=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -vE '^(factory/stations/fix_plan\.py|tests/test_factory_(fix_plan|wiring|planner|manifests)\.py)$' || true)
[ -z "$bad" ] || { echo "files outside ownership staged: $bad"; exit 1; }
grep -q "plan.earlier_than_producer" factory/stations/fix_plan.py || { echo "rule missing from fix_plan.py"; exit 1; }
for name in test_rejects_beat_that_sets_a_fact_an_existing_later_beat_sets test_beat_at_or_after_the_producer_turn_is_not_refused_by_the_earlier_rule test_earlier_rule_ignores_beats_that_set_no_shared_fact; do
  grep -q "def $name" tests/test_factory_fix_plan.py || { echo "test $name missing"; exit 1; }
done
start=$(date +%s)
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 0 tests/test_factory_fix_plan.py
took=$(( $(date +%s) - start ))
echo "fix plan tests took $took s (budget 15 s)"
[ "$took" -le 15 ] || { echo "over the 15 s budget"; exit 1; }
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 4 tests/test_factory_planner.py tests/test_factory_wiring.py tests/test_factory_manifests.py
.venv/bin/python -m ruff check factory tests/test_factory_fix_plan.py
.venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check factory tests/test_factory_fix_plan.py
[ ! -e factory/state/ledger.jsonl ] || { echo "a test wrote factory/state/ledger.jsonl"; exit 1; }
git diff --cached > "$WORK/out/lint-earlier.patch"
test -s "$WORK/out/lint-earlier.patch"
